verdict.rationale: Fenwick's own IP practice group page documents patent prosecution: it prosecuted foundational patents for GoPro, Facebook, Twitter and Venmo, and Managing IP named it Firm of the Year for Patent Prosecution. That covers the documented-practice and group-page parts of the story, but nothing shows portfolio strategy or building a defensible patent position, and drafting and filing are only implied by 'prosecuted'. Patent alerts from Fenwick Labs are adjacent tooling and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit patent portfolio strategy or defensibility counseling, documented application drafting/filing workflow, named patent prosecution practitioners, independent corroboration beyond the firm's own page.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm offers patent prosecution and portfolio strategy — drafting and filing applications and building a defensible patent position — as a documented practice with named practitioners or group pages

citations.quote: We prosecuted the first foundational patents for leading technology giants, including GoPro, Facebook, Twitter and Venmo
Firm of the Year - Nationwide for Patent Prosecution and IP Transactions
